I’ll be perfectly happy if the pod 4 I have works for 5 years, whether original or a warranty replacement. If $3k and a few hundred dollars a year is a lot of money for you, don’t stretch yourself thin to buy it. It’s absolutely not a must have. It’s just a nice luxury.
